definitions.usage: all abroad, enlarge, spread, stretch out.
definitions.full: H7849. shatach [ שָׁטַח ] verb spread, spread abroad (Late Hebrew id. ; Arabic spread out ; so Ethiopic Aramaic שְּׁטַח ); — Qal Perfect 3plural suffix consecutive וּטָחוּם לַשֶּׁמֶשׁ Jer 8:2 they shall spread them abroad, etc ., accusative of many separate things, so Imperfect 3feminine singular וַקתִּשְׁטַךְ 2Sam 17:19 ( עַל location; distinguished from מָּרַשׂ spread covering); 3 masculine plural + infinitive absolute שָׁטוֺחַ לָהֶם וַיִּשְׁטְחוּ Num 11:32 (J) they spread (that is, the quails) for themselves all abroad round about the camp (i.e. to dry them; ᵑ9 siccaverunt; compare Di Gray); Participle לַנּוֺיִם שֹׁטֵחַ Job 12:23 expanding the nations (compare ל 3b ). Pi`el Perfect 1singular כַמָּ֑י אֵלֶיךָ שִׁטַּחְתִּי Psa 88:10 I have spread out unto thee my palms .

occurrences.englishText: The people rose up all that day, and all of that night, and all the next day, and gathered the quails. He who gathered least gathered ten homers; § 1 homer is about 220 liters or 6 bushels and they spread them all out for themselves around the camp.

The people rose up all that day, and all of that night, and all the next day, and gathered the quails. He who gathered least gathered ten homers; § 1 homer is about 220 liters or 6 bushels and they spread them all out for themselves around the camp.
The woman took and spread the covering over the well’s mouth, and spread out crushed grain on it; and nothing was known.
He increases the nations, and he destroys them.
Do you show wonders to the dead?

They will spread them before the sun, the moon, and all the army of the sky, which they have loved, which they have served, after which they have walked, which they have sought, and which they have worshiped. They will not be gathered or be buried. They will be like dung on the surface of the earth.
